name: Aciclovir
description: A guanosine nucleoside analogue that inhibits herpesvirus DNA polymerase after viral thymidine kinase activation, approved for herpes simplex and varicella-zoster infections.

systems.note: Viral DNA polymerase inhibition; the labelled antiviral indication.
Crystalline nephropathy, most marked with intravenous administration; labelled.
Neurotoxicity in renal impairment is labelled.

monitors.why: Crystalline nephropathy is the characteristic risk.
Labelled renal dose adjustment; neurotoxicity follows accumulation.
